items.stem: What is the right default reaction to a Copilot inline suggestion?

options.text: Read it and decide to accept, edit or reject
options.rationale: Correct: suggestions must be read and judged, not accepted by reflex.

options.text: Accept every suggestion to move faster
options.rationale: Reflex acceptance introduces unread, possibly wrong code.

options.text: Assume it is correct because it appeared

items.explanation: Correct: suggestions must be read and judged, not accepted by reflex.

items.stem: Which TWO habits keep everyday Copilot use safe? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Review and test suggested code before committing
options.rationale: Correct: review and tests catch plausible-but-wrong code.

options.text: Keep secrets and private code out of prompts
options.rationale: Correct: prompts should never carry secrets or confidential code.
Unread code can be wrong or unsafe.

items.explanation: Correct: review and tests catch plausible-but-wrong code.

items.stem: Copilot chat gives a weak answer about code it was not shown. What is the likely cause?

options.text: It lacked the context of the relevant files
options.rationale: Correct: chat answers poorly when it cannot see the relevant code.
A weak answer usually means missing context, not a broken model.

options.text: Chat never works on real code
options.rationale: Chat works well when given the right context.

options.text: The code is too simple for Copilot
options.rationale: Simplicity does not cause weak answers.
